skill.name: pytest-recording
skill.description: Configure pytest-recording and VCR.py tests, manage cassettes, record or replay HTTP interactions, and filter secrets from recorded traffic.
skill.summary: Guide pytest-recording setup for reliable HTTP tests with sanitized VCR cassettes.
skill.author: bossjones

security_audit.summary: All static findings were adjudicated as false positives after reviewing SKILL.md. The flagged patterns are Markdown examples, VCR redaction settings, local loopback ignore-host configuration, or normal cassette debugging guidance.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes commands that can make live HTTP requests when recording is disabled or cassettes are refreshed.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short warning to run live-recording commands only with test credentials and reviewed redaction settings.

remediation.issue: Secret filtering examples depend on users adding every provider-specific header or query parameter.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend reviewing generated cassettes before commit and extending filters for each provider used by the project.

static_findings.snippet: | `none` | `--vcr-record=none` | Only replay, fail if no cassette |
Cassettes are stored in `tests/cassettes/` by default, organized by test module:
1. Run with `--vcr-record=once` to create missing cassettes
2. Or use `--vcr-record=rewrite` to refresh all cassettes
3. Add any query param auth to `filter_query_parameters`
3. Verify cassette file exists and is valid YAML

content.value_statement: HTTP tests often fail when live APIs change or credentials leak. This skill helps configure pytest-recording cassettes and sanitize recorded requests.
actual_capabilities: Explains pytest-recording record modes for replay, rewrite, and new episodes.
Shows how to mark tests with VCR cassettes and custom cassette names.
Provides vcr_config examples for filtering headers and query parameters.
Describes cassette storage paths and common debugging steps.
Lists common LLM provider authentication headers to redact.
limitations: Does not install pytest-recording or VCR.py for the user.
Does not verify that every project-specific secret is filtered.
Does not replace live integration tests for API behavior changes.
Requires users to review recorded cassette files before committing them.

use_cases.title: Add Stable API Tests
use_cases.description: Create pytest tests that replay recorded HTTP responses instead of calling live services every run.

use_cases.title: Review Cassette Hygiene
use_cases.description: Check cassette configuration so authentication headers and query parameters are redacted before sharing code.

use_cases.title: Maintain Existing Cassettes
use_cases.description: Refresh, debug, and organize VCR cassettes when API responses or request matching rules change.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic VCR Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for one HTTP call.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me write a pytest-recording test for one API call. Include the marker, cassette name, and expected assertions.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Secret Filtering
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my pytest-recording configuration and suggest filters for authentication headers, API keys, tokens, and cookies.

prompt_templates.title: Debug a Cassette Mismatch
prompt_templates.scenario: A replayed request no longer matches the cassette.
prompt_templates.prompt: A pytest-recording test cannot match its cassette. Help me inspect match_on settings, cassette paths, and safe refresh options.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Recording Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for a team test suite.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a pytest-recording workflow for CI and local development. Include record modes, cassette review rules, and provider-specific redaction.

output_examples.input: Ask for a first pytest-recording test around one API client method.
output_examples.output: A short test plan with a VCR marker, cassette name, replay expectations, and guidance for first-time recording.

output_examples.input: Ask how to prevent OpenAI and Anthropic credentials from appearing in cassettes.
output_examples.output: A redaction checklist covering authorization headers, API key headers, query parameters, cookies, and manual cassette review.

output_examples.input: Ask why a recorded cassette no longer matches a request.
output_examples.output: A debugging sequence that checks request matching fields, cassette paths, stale data, and safe re-recording choices.

best_practices: Use least-privilege test credentials when creating or refreshing cassettes.
Review cassette diffs before commit to confirm secrets and cookies are redacted.
Keep record mode strict in CI so tests do not call live APIs unexpectedly.
anti_patterns: Do not commit cassettes before checking them for tokens or private response data.
Do not use rewrite mode casually when deterministic test behavior matters.
Do not disable recording in CI unless live external calls are explicitly approved.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It helps configure pytest-recording and VCR.py so HTTP tests can record, replay, and sanitize API interactions.

faq.question: Does it make live network calls by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance. Live calls happen only when users run tests in a recording mode that contacts APIs.

faq.question: Can it prevent all secret leaks?
faq.answer: No. It recommends common filters, but each project must review cassettes and add provider-specific redaction rules.

faq.question: Is it useful for LLM provider tests?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance names common authentication headers used by OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Google AI, and Cohere.

faq.question: How should teams use it in CI?
faq.answer: Use replay-only or strict record modes in CI so tests stay deterministic and avoid unexpected external API calls.

faq.question: What should I do when an API response changes?
faq.answer: Inspect the mismatch, confirm redaction settings, then refresh only the cassette that needs updated behavior.
